messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered for INC-1382 — increased 504s from us-west-2 in serving-tier. Auto-assigning to ben_oncall.

alice_sre: saw the same in dashboards — spike in 5xxs starting ~12:04 UTC, 90th p95 latency up 3x. lots of ELB 504 from target group tg-svc-serve-usw2a.

ben_oncall: taking it. oncall-runbook steps now. quick check — are we seeing cloudwatch target health failures?

carla_net: I see ENI attach/detach flaps in us-west-2a and elevated connection resets on the fabric. AWS console shows ASG instances up but some ENIs not routing.

ben_oncall: running target health describe:
```bash
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:111111:targetgroup/tg-svc-serve-usw2a/aaaa1111 
```

ben_oncall: output is noisy — ~30% targets unhealthy (Connection_Error / Timeout).

alice_sre: EBS and EC2 fine, but kernel logs show `NETDEV WATCHDOG` and `device eth0 entered promiscuous mode` on some hosts. looks like NIC flaps.

carla_net: correlating with AZ telemetry — us-west-2a AZ fabric reports transient packet drops. opening AWS support ticket now.

aws-alerts: AWS Health: Investigating — Networking connectivity issues in Availability Zone us-west-2a. (Case: 1234567890)

ben_oncall: immediate mitigation: shift Route53 weighted routing for api.redwood.internal -> move 70% traffic to us-west-2b/2c, 30% to usw2a. will push small increments.

alice_sre: +1. update cloudfront/origins? This affects internal regional endpoints and dedicated pools, double-check routing policies for dedicated customers pinned to usw2a.

david_prod: For Dedicated tenants pinned to usw2a we have to contact CS — they might need manual failover. eva_cs can you start outreach? include guidance on potential brief reconnections.

eva_cs: on it. drafting message to affected teammates and PG owners. will ping customer success leads with list of impacted accounts (from capacity map).

ben_oncall: executing Route53 change now — small step to 50/50 first to watch for errors.
```json
{ "Comment": "temporary weight shift due to AZ networking" , "Changes": [ { "Action": "UPSERT", "ResourceRecordSet": { "Name": "api.redwood.internal.", "Type": "A", "SetIdentifier": "usw2b", "Weight": 50, "TTL": 30, "ResourceRecords": [{"Value": "3.101.12.34"}] } } ] }
```

carla_net: also adding ELB connection draining increase to 120s and enabling cross-zone load balancing for the layer serving cluster to mitigate sticky instances.

alice_sre: monitoring dashboards — p95 latency moving down in us-west-2 overall, 5xx% dropping. but we still see tail errors for specific customers hitting pinned endpoints.

ben_oncall: I'm starting a canary redirect: update service discovery to prefer us-west-2b for new sessions. leaving existing sessions alone.

david_prod: deploying a hotfix that forces HTTP keepalive reduction on busy hosts to reduce conntrack pressure (small config change). rolling to 10% of hosts in usw2a.

ben_oncall: AWS case updated: attachments and pcap from our side uploaded. AWS requested traceroute and ENI metrics. carla — can you share the pcap link?

carla_net: uploaded to internal S3: s3://redwood-incident/INC-1382/pcap-usw2a-1204.pcap — shared with AWS case.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Postmortem checklist note added to INC-1382. Please add timeline entries.

eva_cs: outreach sent to 6 enterprise customers with dedicated pools in usw2a. provided workaround: switch endpoint to us-west-2b or enable regional fallback in config. awaiting replies.

ben_oncall: new observation: ELB subnets in usw2a show intermittent high latency to targets — looks like hypervisor host-level NIC congestion. pushing request to AWS to move impacted hosts off noisy hardware.

alice_sre: on-call handoff in ~20m. ben, do you want a formal handoff or do you want continued ownership?

ben_oncall: I'll stay on until AWS confirms host mitigation or traffic fully shifted. handoff only after that. I'll update rotation if needed.

david_prod: ops note — scaling up capacity in usw2b by +30% to absorb shifted traffic. running auto-scale policy change.

carla_net: AWS replied: investigating fabric issue in us-west-2a, ETA 45-90 mins for mitigation. will provide host remediations.

eva_cs: Customer replies trickling in — two customers requested immediate failover; performed manual DNS change for them and validated connectivity.

ben_oncall: current impact summary for ops: 
- scope: Region us-west-2, AZ us-west-2a only
- symptom: increased 5xx/504s, ELB target failures, connection resets
- impact: ~18% request error-rate increase region-wide, concentrated on endpoints pinned to us-west-2a dedicated pools
- mitigation: Route53 weighted shift, ELB cross-zone + draining, reduce keepalive, scale in usw2b, customer manual failovers where requested

alice_sre: will add monitoring alert thresholds to watch for rollback — if p95 latency > 2s for 5m then automated shift back to original weights.

incident-bot: :memo: Incident channel archived note will be added after RCA and timeline complete.

ben_oncall: AWS update: they are decommissioning 3 noisy hypervisors and scheduling live migration of ENIs. continuing to monitor.

carla_net: FYI — no EBS detach errors observed, storage looks healthy. this is strictly network fabric/ENI packet loss.

eva_cs: customers updated. will reopen if any escalations.

ben_oncall: ok team — we'll keep this channel for live updates. if AWS confirms host migrations and our metrics remain stable for 30m I'll start preparing a controlled re-weight back to normal. thanks everyone.

alice_sre: thanks — recording timeline in postmortem doc now.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-1382 status: mitigated -> monitoring. assigned owner: ben_oncall.
